g.title: public.services
g.text: The treatment catalog. duration_minutes is client-facing; buffers extend the blocked window. Prices in cents. requires_intake gates booking once intake forms exist. Deactivated, never deleted.
Cleanup/reset time appended to the blocked window; invisible to the client-facing times.

g.title: public.organizations
g.text: Tenant root. Single row today; every domain table hangs off organization_id for future multi-tenancy.

g.title: public.service_resource_requirements
g.text: Service -> room TYPE requirement; a concrete free room of the type is assigned at booking.

g.title: public.service_resource_requirements:service_id->public.services:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

g.title: public.service_staff
g.text: Qualification: who may perform what, with optional per-staff duration/price overrides that the slot and booking routes apply.

g.title: public.service_staff:service_id->public.services:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

g.title: public.appointment_services
g.text: Line items with name/price/duration SNAPSHOTS taken at booking: catalog edits never rewrite booked history.
